summary: Euroseas Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, announcing its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for July 23, 2026, along with the related proxy statement and proxy card. The filing is a routine administrative notice for an annual general meeting, providing shareholders with meeting details and access to financial reports. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change is involved. This is a standard corporate governance filing with no transactional or extraordinary elements.
